bootstrap_note: Members resampled with replacement, 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles. The same resamples are used for every approach, so differences are paired. The model is not refit inside the bootstrap.
ranking_note: Top-k metrics rank by the raw score, ties broken by member id. Both test years are ranked together.

calibration_before_after.note: Isotonic regression fit on the calibration year only, evaluated here on the test years. Slope and intercept clip probabilities to [0.0001, 0.9999].

prior_cost_plus_pregnancy_rule.rule: pregnant on the index date first, then by last year's cost

model_only_prior_cost_rank.note: Where the members found only by the model sit in the prior-cost ranking (0 is the highest prior cost, the rule's cut is at 0.10).
